blocks.text: WASHINGTON—US President Donald Trump praised Nvidia’s decision on Monday to reinstate Jensen Huang as chief executive, as Democratic leaders vowed investigations and prominent Republicans questioned whether his return posed a national security risk. Trump also posted a doctored version of the famous photograph of him raising his fist after surviving a 2024 assassination attempt, replacing himself with Huang, who brandished a red bra beneath an Nvidia flag. The image appeared to allude to the scandal that forced Huang, cofounder of the artificial intelligence chip giant, to resign less than two weeks earlier following revelations of extramarital affairs, including with a woman […]...
